description: User-collected phone videos. Windows are manual review bounds around pushes, excluding hand resets; not exact contact annotations.

object.description: Rigid robot top cover, no wheels, sliding on base

pusher.marker_to_contact_offset_note: User measured approximately 11 mm from the front pink marker centre to the contacting caliper edge. Physical distance; not a calibrated tabletop-projected offset. Original tracks are preserved; contact_proxy experiments extrapolate along the observed marker vector by 1.1/4.
pusher.user_note: Caliper shaft was close to flat but not resting flat on the table. User confirmed the same edge was used in every push and confirmed all four direction labels.
